Raising one's hand for dua before Iftar 2507 views Q. Assalaamu alaikum wa rahmatullah, Dear Sheikh, I pray to Allah SWT that you are enjoying a good health & high Islamic spirit. (1) It has come to my knowledge that some people observe certain nawwafil salaah by reciting any specific surah a certain number of times( that is more than once) in each raka'ah after reading surah faati'ha. Sometimes they would make an extra sajdah after reading the tashahhud & darood and there, they would ask for any specific doah they are in need for. They would even call this salah as haajaat. However I have not cross of any of this kind of salaah in the ahadeeth. Could you please enlighten me on this. (2) My second question is about those 'aamil who after asking someone's name & mother's name, claim that they make istikhaarah salah in order to find out if that person is under the influence of jiin or evil eyes etc. As far as i understand, Istikhaarah salaah is accomplished when someone is unsure of whether doing something is good for him/her or not. But what I don't understand is how Istikhaarah salaah can help someone to find out the malady of someone else. Would that not be more appropriate to offer haajah salaah in this context? I look forward to your valuable views and comments on the above two issues Incha Allah. I thank you in anticipation for your cooperation. Wassalaam. 2469 views Q. dua of sifa 5816 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 151085 Country: India Title: About the condition of father Question: My father name is Irshad Khan. He is been married for 34 years. 15 years ago he had paralysis but continue to work despite of sickness. After 15 years he again got hemorrhage this time another side got paralyzed. Now he is at home. My mother do all his things like potty bathing food and all. My father’s sisters used to come home and bring sweet dish and feed that only to my father with their hands only. Nowadays my father used to fight my mother daily and began to hurt himself and told my mother to get out. He made my mother’s life hell. But she do her fardh regularly. My father’s sisters are quite happy with that. Because from the beginning they want our house because one is widow and other did not marry live in our home. Please tell me if my father has any effect or its just sickness. Please suggest some wazifah too. Answer ID: 151085 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 840/770/SD=9/1438) Whatever condition of your father you wrote apparently tells that your father is suffering from some illness, you should consult any expert physician. Moreover, recite Surah Fatiha seven times in the morning and evening and blow on your father. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
